Live from a windy Basin Reserve in Wellington, The Hindu and Sportstar preview the crucial India vs New Zealand Test series. With India’s World Test Championship (WTC) final hopes hanging in the balance—requiring at least six wins from their remaining seven Tests—captain Shubman Gill and head coach Gautam Gambhir face a major selection dilemma on a lush green pitch. In this on-ground report, The Hindu’s Amol Karhadkar break down India’s strategy.
